_comment: RIVET'S COLOUR IS #b0512f — weathered oxide, HSL hue 15.8 deg. Ruled by the
maintainer 2026-09-01 after three rounds: #d63a33 and #de3b4b were both
rejected as too red, and the brief settled on a rusty rivet.
It sits 11.8 deg from Ignition's #ef7c1a, which is CLOSER than any accent
this family has ever rejected (the three killed in one pass sat at 7, 8 and
10 deg) and far closer than the 32 deg the accepted jade held. That was put
to the maintainer with the numbers in front of him and he ruled it: he did
not mind crowding Ignition, since the two projects will live side by side
(.rulings/ R-294). Recorded here so nobody re-litigates it as an oversight
— it is a decision, not a missed check.
The two projects are separated by saturation and lightness rather than hue;
Ignition is a vivid flame orange, Rivet a muted corroded red-brown.
#b0512f is LIGHT-BIASED — 5.17 white, 4.77 paper, but only 3.65 on dark
chrome and 3.52 on the icon tile. That is the family's weakest dark reading,
below the 3.84 that retired Trends' #12805e. So `accent` carries a small lift
to #c06139 (4.51 dark chrome, 4.34 on tile) for the dark lockup, the dark
descriptor and the dark tile, and `accent_on_light` holds the ruled #b0512f
for every light lockup. This is the Olympus mechanism, inverted: there the
accent vanished on white, here it dims on black.
Tiles are dark warm oxide rather than Ignition's neutral slate, and they are
DARK on purpose: a warm charcoal #332e2c read 2.59:1 against the mark and
failed 3:1 outright. Every number above is from check_color.py; see
BRAND.html section 3 for the full table.
